inspiration.observed_pattern: A REPLACE INTO reads a DISTINCT subset from a joined source relation, left joins existing target rows, and applies the replacement only when the source is new or newer.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized to one stale target, one newer linked source duplicated through two links, and one new linked source.

fixture_notes: Resource alpha is replaced by revision 2 after duplicate source rows collapse; beta is inserted at revision 1.
determinism_notes: Resource keys, revisions, links, payloads, and ordered final-state checks are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE resource_catalog (resource_key VARCHAR(24) PRIMARY KEY, revision INT NOT NULL, body VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE incoming_resources (incoming_id INT PRIMARY KEY, resource_key VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, revision INT NOT NULL, body VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE incoming_resource_links (link_id INT PRIMARY KEY, incoming_id INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: REPLACE INTO resource_catalog (resource_key, revision, body) SELECT candidate.resource_key, candidate.revision, candidate.body FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.resource_key, i.revision, i.body FROM incoming_resource_links AS l JOIN incoming_resources AS i ON l.incoming_id = i.incoming_id) AS candidate LEFT JOIN resource_catalog AS current ON current.resource_key = candidate.resource_key WHERE current.resource_key IS NULL OR candidate.revision > current.revision

checks.sql: SELECT resource_key, revision, body FROM resource_catalog ORDER BY resource_key
SELECT incoming_id, resource_key, revision, body FROM incoming_resources ORDER BY incoming_id
SELECT link_id, incoming_id FROM incoming_resource_links ORDER BY link_id
